hookText: Michael Nielsen took down his book on neural nets

beats.say: At the time, I expected AGI systems based on neural networks to be many decades away, but to bring remarkable benefits for humanity.
With the extraordinarily reckless behaviour of the frontier labs, the systems have raced ahead much faster than I expected1, giving humanity far too little time to meet the challenges.
Even if you can get a reduction from 10% down to 9%, you would, on net, be saving 80 million lives in expectation.
